D1 格 - 範: standard; rule or regulation
D2 標 - 範: standard or model used as a criterion
D3 様 - 範: example; pattern or model
D4 形 - 範: form or pattern
D5 本 - 範: model or example to follow
D6 倣 - 範: following or imitating a model
D7 像 - 範: model or representation
D8 囲 - 範: bounded frame or scope
D9 限 - 範: bounds or limits
D10 境 - 範: boundary or bounded scope
D11 界 - 範: bounds or delimited domain
D12 広 - 範: wide or extensive scope
D13 方 - 範: category; way or method
D14 度 - 範: measure or extent; standard of measurement
D15 道 - 範: rule; doctrine or normative way
D16 計 - 範: measurement or standard length
D17 測 - 範: measure or gauge
D18 量 - 範: measure or measurement
D19 坂 - 範: slope, including the engineering sense of のり
D20 理 - 範: principle or normative rule
E1 型 - Compare model, pattern and standard-form senses with 範 and verify the direct guard.
E2 例 - Compare example and precedent with 範 and verify the direct guard.
E3 規 - Compare standard and rule with 範 and verify the direct guard.
E4 則 - Compare rule and following a model with 範 and verify the direct guard.
E5 法 - Compare law, rule and method with 範 and verify the direct guard.
E6 典 - Compare rules and model with 範 and verify the direct guard.
E7 準 - Compare standard and conforming to a model with 範 and verify the direct guard.
E8 師 - Assess the claimed ordinary model or exemplar secondary sense and the direct guard.
E9 象 - Compare modeling-on and representation senses with 範 and verify the direct guard.
E10 儀 - Assess model or exemplar senses beyond ceremony, including 儀範 and 地球儀, and the direct guard.
